parts:
Hi,

it could be either a bad array or corrupt annotation files. I don't
know which UFL annotation data file you are using, but I recommend
that you download the most recent one from

http://aroma-project.org/data/annotationData/chipTypes/Mapping50K_Hind240/

and then confirm that you get:

> library("aroma.affymetrix");
> cdf <- AffymetrixCdfFile$byChipType("Mapping50K_Hind240");
> ufl <- getAromaUflFile(cdf);
> ufl
## AromaUflFile:
## Name: Mapping50K_Hind240
## Tags: na31,hg19,HB20110328
## Full name: Mapping50K_Hind240,na31,hg19,HB20110328
## Pathname: annotationData/chipTypes/Mapping50K_Hind240/Mapping50K_Hind240,na31,hg
## 19,HB20110328.ufl
## File size: 112.52 kB (115220 bytes)
## RAM: 0.00 MB
## Number of data rows: 57299
## File format: v1
## Dimensions: 57299x1
## Column classes: integer
## Number of bytes per column: 2
## Footer: <createdOn>20110328 19:07:16
PDT</createdOn><platform>Affymetrix</platform>
## <chipType>Mapping50K_Hind240</chipType><createdBy><fullname>Henrik Bengtsson
## </fullname><email>h...@aroma-project.org</email></createdBy><srcFiles><srcFile1>
## <filename>Mapping50K_Hind240.CDF</filename><filesize>56029390</filesize>
## <checksum>84239fce7a443dd528e060731a8df77e</checksum></srcFile1>
## <srcFile2<filename>Mapping50K_Hind240.na31.annot.csv</filename><filesize>82648011</filesize>
## <checksum>3a73a05bf7432371982d1553f067f84a</checksum></srcFile2></srcFiles>
## Chip type: Mapping50K_Hind240
## Platform: Affymetrix
> getFileSize(ufl)
[1] 115220
> getChecksum(ufl)
[1] "706c5e80c3dc8d3700f6ca58e1f18a52"

If this is not what you had, retry with the above UFL. If you still
get the same error, something is wrong with the data.

/Henrik
